upper_mass_policy: Subtract articulated yaw and pitch mass from ChassisMassKg; preserve total upper assembly mass.
self_collision_policy: Exclude pairs of bodies belonging to this vehicle only; retain contact with other robots and the static world.
inertia_policy: Homogeneous source convex-assembly inertia, rescaled to current drive-profile part mass; not a hardware measurement.
notes: Current drive-profile.json owns drive and suspension constants.
Original UE visual meshes and materials remain unchanged.
All movement and contact in this backend are solved by MuJoCo; visual transform updates only reproduce its output.
